description: Although Carlos had decided to fight against the gang of bandits to protect his home, he ended up being taken hostage by them instead. The bandits demanded that the girl exchange her relic gun for Carlos's life, but unbeknownst to them the young boy had already lit the fuse tied to the explosives he was carrying, ready to die to protect his homeland. The girl prevented an explosion by shooting off the fuse with her gun, but the commotion created by it all left the bandits at a disadvantage. Once the battle ended, Carlos taught his tribe the true meaning of justice, and instilled in them a sense of duty when it comes to protecting their sanctuary.
summon: So this is real justice...Guess the sanctuary can't teach us everything.We should go out and learn more.
fusion: Look, my new prototype!I wonder where the testing site is...Hey, be careful with that!
evolution: I can finally protect the mines and my people with this!Thanks...I'm only saying it once, so I hope you heard me the first time.
